subject: Literature
title: Carson McCullers and the Lonely Heart
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Carson McCullers and the Lonely Heart.

hook.text: Carson McCullers published her first novel at twenty-three and was hailed as a genius of American loneliness.

buildup.text: The Heart Is a Lonely Hunter follows misfits in a small Georgia town who pour their souls into a deaf-mute man.

discovery.text: McCullers wrote about isolation, queerness, and racial injustice in the Deep South decades before others dared.

twist.text: She suffered strokes in her twenties that left her partially paralyzed, yet she kept writing through immense pain.

climax.text: McCullers proved that the literature of loneliness could be as powerful as the literature of love.

punchline.text: She made loneliness the subject that American fiction needed.

quiz.question: What themes did McCullers explore decades before others?
options: Isolation, queerness, and racial injustice in the Deep South
